input.oldString:
def run_mock_servers():
    socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
    with socketserver.TCPServer(("127.0.0.1", PORT_OLLAMA), MockOllamaHandler) as httpd_ollama:
        threading.Thread(target=httpd_ollama.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
        with socketserver.TCPServer(("127.0.0.1", PORT_LITELLM), MockLiteLLMHandler) as httpd_litellm:
            threading.Thread(target=httpd_litellm.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
            import time
            while True:
                time.sleep(1)
